headless_full_run.note: The fresh-process persistence check failed once at the ended-phase assertion during the full run. It passed five subsequent isolated executions, including three with independent test directories. No persistence logic or assertion was changed; phase/seed diagnostic logging was added. Cause remains unconfirmed.

rendered_final.note: One local GL launch failed because the virtual display could not start; subsequent completed runs above use isolated displays.

packed_startup.method: Exported a Web PCK and ran startup_flow_test from a directory containing no project.godot, using explicit --main-pack. The legacy test packed-label heuristic prints false and was not used as evidence.

limitations: Fresh-process persistence test had one unreproduced failure; retained explicitly above.
Physical Android hardware and Windows GPU performance were not measured.
Existing ObjectDB shutdown warnings are recorded separately by the runners.
Save format/content ID migration and release pack selection were intentionally unchanged.
